⭕️ U.S. War Secretary: “We didn’t start this war”

Secretary of War Pete Hegseth claimed President Trump, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, special envoy Steve Witkoff, and Jared Kushner “bent over backwards for real diplomacy,” but said Iran was “not negotiating” and instead “stalling” to rebuild its missile stockpiles.

That account clashes with Oman’s last-minute plea to Washington on the eve of the strikes not to abandon diplomacy, saying progress had been made and that Iran had offered unprecedented concessions on the nuclear file. The talks were narrowly focused on nuclear limits and sanctions relief. Missiles were not part of the negotiations.

Hegseth framed the escalation as long-overdue “retribution,” arguing Iran has waged a “savage, one-sided war” against the U.S. for nearly half a century through proxy attacks.

“Their war on Americans has become our retribution against their Ayatollah and his death cult,” he said.

He added: “We didn’t start this war, but under President Trump, we are finishing it.”

He did not mention the 1953 U.S.-backed coup in Iran, Washington’s support for the Shah’s rule from 1953 to 1979, or that the U.S. and Israel launched the February 28 strikes.

result.text:
🚨 NEW | U.S. F-15E crashes in Kuwait — two American crew members successfully eject

A U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle crashed in Al Jahra, west of Kuwait City, on March 2. Both the pilot and weapons systems officer successfully ejected and survived. Video circulating online shows local residents assisting one of the crew in a civilian truck.

The crash site in Al Jahra was geolocated by OSINT researcher Christiaan Triebert. Debris reportedly fell inside the Mina Al Ahmadi refinery complex, injuring at least two refinery workers.

No official cause has been confirmed.

➤ Some reports suggest possible friendly fire from a Patriot air defense battery during heightened alert.
➤ Iranian state-linked media claims the aircraft was shot down.
➤ Mechanical failure is also possible, with online reports noting footage showed smoke and one engine on fire before the jet spiraled down.

More details 👇
